chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Aban, from Ali ibn Abi Hamza, from Abu Basir, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
I asked him about a woman who was found with a man under one garment. So he said: Both of them shall be flogged one hundred lashes.

key_terms.ثَوْب وَاحِد: A single garment — being found together under one garment implies illicit intimacy
key_terms.مِائَةَ جَلْدَةٍ: One hundred lashes — the prescribed hadd punishment for zina (unlawful sexual intercourse)
key_terms.يُجْلَدَانِ: They both shall be flogged — dual passive verb indicating the punishment applies equally to both parties

ai.seo_question: What is the Islamic ruling for a man and woman found together under one garment?
ai.summary: Abu Basir narrates that he asked Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) about the legal ruling for a man and woman found together under a single garment. The Imam ruled that both parties would receive one hundred lashes as the prescribed punishment. This ruling falls under the chapter on what obligates the hadd of flogging, establishing that illicit physical proximity — even without proven zina (fornication) — may warrant the same punishment as fornication under Islamic law.
